**Designing grouped carry lookahead**

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_fast_add #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter SUBTRACT = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] s
);
    localparam BLOCKS = (WIDTH+3)/4;
    localparam PAD_WIDTH = BLOCKS*4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(BLOCKS);
    wire [PAD_WIDTH-1:0] p, g;
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS-1:0] bg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [BLOCKS:0] carry;
    assign carry[0] = (SUBTRACT != 0);
    genvar i, j, l;
    generate
        for (i=0; i<PAD_WIDTH; i=i+1) begin: bit_terms
            if (i < WIDTH) begin: real_bit
                wire y;
                assign y = b[i] ^ (SUBTRACT != 0);
                assign p[i] = a[i] ^ y;
                assign g[i] = a[i] & y;
            end else begin: padding
                assign p[i] = 1'b1;
                assign g[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        for (j=0; j<BLOCKS; j=j+1) begin: blocks
            assign bp[0][j] = &p[4*j +: 4];
            assign bg[0][j] = g[4*j+3] |
                (p[4*j+3] & g[4*j+2]) |
                (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1]) |
                (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]);
            assign carry[j+1] = bg[LEVELS][j] |
                (bp[LEVELS][j] & (SUBTRACT != 0));
            for (i=0; i<4; i=i+1) begin: sum_bits
                if (4*j+i < WIDTH) begin: real_sum
                    wire c;
                    if (i == 0) begin: c0
                        assign c = carry[j];
                    end else if (i == 1) begin: c1
                        assign c = g[4*j] | (p[4*j] & carry[j]);
                    end else if (i == 2) begin: c2
                        assign c = g[4*j+1] | (p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]) |
                            (p[4*j+1] & p[4*j] & carry[j]);
                    end else begin: c3
                        assign c = g[4*j+2] | (p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1]) |
                            (p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]) |
                            (p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & p[4*j] & carry[j]);
                    end
                    assign s[4*j+i] = p[4*j+i] ^ c;
                end
            end
        end
        for (l=0; l<LEVELS; l=l+1) begin: prefix_levels
            for (j=0; j<BLOCKS; j=j+1) begin: prefix_blocks
                if (j >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign bg[l+1][j] = bg[l][j] |
                        (bp[l][j] & bg[l][j-(1 << l)]);
                    assign bp[l+1][j] = bp[l][j] & bp[l][j-(1 << l)];
                end else begin: pass
                    assign bg[l+1][j] = bg[l][j];
                    assign bp[l+1][j] = bp[l][j];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, ab_result, ba_result;
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUBTRACT(0)) add_unit
        (.a(a), .b(b), .s(add_result));
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUBTRACT(1)) ab_unit
        (.a(a), .b(b), .s(ab_result));
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUBTRACT(1)) ba_unit
        (.a(b), .b(a), .s(ba_result));
    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = ab_result;
            3'b010: sum = ba_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end
    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );
    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index=0; index<STAGES-1; index=index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The operand-register to first output-register path includes 32-bit arithmetic carry propagation, ALU operation selection, and synchronous-reset gating. Carry propagation is the primary target.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the three inferred arithmetic operators with parallel four-bit-block carry-lookahead adders. Block generate/propagate terms feed a logarithmic prefix network; each sum bit uses a short local lookahead. Keep the original operation case, pipeline hierarchy, named registers, resets, and valid propagation unchanged.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit block-prefix structure bounds long-distance carry propagation to three prefix levels for WIDTH=32, followed by local lookahead and sum XOR. This is intended to improve setup WNS if the reference mapping uses a slower carry structure. No numerical timing gain is claimed without mapped STA.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Additional prefix logic and routing can increase combinational area and capacitance. No registers or pipeline stages are added. Compliance with the 10341.668480um2 cap and electrical limits requires evaluation with the specified mapping and physical flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All arithmetic is modulo 2^WIDTH. Both subtraction directions, all four bitwise operations, and the opcode-111 zero default are preserved. The sequential RTL is unchanged, including synchronous reset priority, unconditional data advancement, registered latency, and behavior when valid is low. No initialization or startup assumptions are introduced. The helper supports positive WIDTH values, and the original STAGES structure is retained."
}
